title: Your case manager
seo_title: Your case manager during sickness absence • React2u
seo_description: After you report sick, you get a regular case manager from React2u. What does your case manager do, and how do you reach them?

data.heading: Your case manager
data.text: After you report sick, you get a regular case manager. They guide you until you are back at work, together with your employer and the company doctor (bedrijfsarts).
data.cardNote: Available on working days. Ask for your case manager, or leave a message.

data.heading: Someone who stands beside you
data.text: Your case manager is there for you and for your employer, with respect for everyone's role and privacy.

cards.title: One regular contact
cards.text: Your case manager stays the same throughout. You only have to tell your story once.

cards.title: Listens and thinks along
cards.text: We ask how you are doing and what you need, and look together at what you can do.

cards.title: Keeps the overview
cards.text: Appointments, conversations and documents are in one online file, so you also know where you stand.

cards.title: Liaises with your employer
cards.text: Your case manager coordinates with your employer and the company doctor, so you can focus on your recovery.

cards.title: Confidential
cards.text: You can speak to your case manager in confidence. Medical information you share only with the company doctor.

cards.title: Brings in the right help
cards.text: A physiotherapist, psychologist or coach if that helps. We arrange it together with your employer.

items.title: Healthy
items.text: Work gives structure, contact and income. That is why we help you back to work that suits you.

items.title: Human
items.text: We listen, we are there for you and we help you back to work at your own pace.

items.title: Clear
items.text: When you are out of action for a while, it can be hard to keep everything in order. In our online platform you can find all your conversations, appointments and documents.

data.heading: Don't know who your case manager is?
data.text: Call us. We will find out for you and put you through.
